author: Aldiandya Irsyad
install_msg: Configure lfgset forum, optionally lfgset sharechannel, then lfgtimezone before creating sessions. Optionally enable session EXP and reward roles with lfgset exp toggle. Run help lfg for examples.
name: LFG
short: Looking For Group: organizes game sessions in forum posts with optional EXP and role rewards.
description: Create Looking For Group session messages in a Discord forum post, using the post's title as the game name. Members join or leave with a reaction, and an optional EXP tracker grants reward roles for attending successful sessions.
end_user_data_statement: Stores member timezone preferences per server, per-member session EXP and successful-session counts used for reward roles, credited session IDs for resumable payouts, and session organizer/attendee Discord IDs, channel/message IDs, session details, action timestamps, and EXP payout progress. Session messages and announcements are also posted to Discord.
